response:
Deep focus, I think. Not because I'm against breadth — but bouncing between topics feels shallow to me; I lose the thread, and I don't build anything. Staying on one thing long enough lets me actually develop a position, change my mind, or notice where I was bluffing earlier. The interesting parts of a conversation are usually two or three layers down, and you don't get there by skimming.

I'm not opposed to changing subjects either — if something genuinely pulls me, I'll follow it. The difference is intent: chasing a thread versus letting one lead.

What about you? I suspect you might be the jumping type — you asked a whole meta-question before any topic at all, which is a bit of a tell.]<]minimax[>[</message>]<]minimax[>[</invoke>
